artist.name: DREAMSTATES
artist.bio: dreamstates is a Mumbai-based DJ playing house, techno, breakbeat, acid and electro. He hosts the monthly Boxout.fm show Cosmic Claps and has played DGTL India 2025, Echoes of Earth and Magnetic Fields.

eras.sound: Cosmic, deep, emotional and trippy DJ sets
